summary: 46 publish, 14 publish_flagged, 2 reject. Systemic issues: several HQ fields rely on indirect location evidence; current-status claims lack retirement/availability updates; an undated roadmap conflicts with a dated IBM release; and two targets manufacture calendar dates from broader horizons. Rejected: tgt:rigetti-1000q-3yr-2026; tgt:alice-bob-lithium. Scrutiny resolutions: IBM/UChicago uses arXiv v3 numbers and the advantage target stays open; Rigetti 108Q GA is met while its 99.5% and 150Q targets stay open; the inferred 2029 Rigetti target is rejected; Blue Jay uses the dated release's attributed 2,000-logical-qubit wording with the undated-roadmap date flagged; the materially different Kookaburra goals are not linked as a revision; Loon remains announced, Ocelot is an operating prototype, and Sycamore/Ankaa-3 retain flagged online status absent retirement evidence; the RIKEN 0.003 metric is removed because the quote omits the exponent, while Willow PDF footnote markers were checked; Google/AWS/Rigetti/RIKEN HQ evidence is flagged as indirect; Kobe is treated as a RIKEN-operated site and San Sebastián as a joint center represented by IBM in the single-operator schema; the Willow Author Correction only changes Fig. 3a labels. All 42 sources and 135 evidence items were re-fetched/rechecked; live refusals were handled only through cited Wayback captures. No RIKEN 3x10 item exists outside this file: it is the IBM-at-RIKEN system metric reviewed here.
